name: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED C.E. 73: Stargazer
summary:
Mobile Suit Gundam SEED C.E.73 -STARGAZER- is a side story to the anime TV series, Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. As of July 2006, it is being streamed on Bandai Channel as an original net animation. The show is directed by Susumu Nishizawa and written by Shigeru Morita, both staff members of Gundam SEED Destiny.

The series consists of three episodes, each running at 15-minutes long. The web broadcast began in July 2006, with a new episode showing monthly. A DVD containing all three episodes as well as the two 5-minute long Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Astray animated shorts was released on November 24, 2006. This DVD also contained a different ending for Stage 3 in which several scenes after the Phantom Pain attack are shown.

A manga adaptation of the series has been released in 2007. Authored by Naoki Moriya, it features an epilogue reveals the previously uncertain fate of Selene and Sven as they are shown to be alive and mostly unharmed from their ordeal. Sven joins the DSSD.

name: The Way Out
summary: Mel Giedroyc drops two teams of comedians, led by Ed Gamble and Nish Kumar, into four bespoke, themed escape rooms with one simple instruction: the winner is the first team to find 'the way out'.

name: «ЖИВЫЕ ГОЛОСА»
summary:
"Live Voices" about the Great Victory is a large-scale project in which famous actors, comedians, artists, and bloggers read poems by Soviet poets and poetsesses about the Great Patriotic War.

Each episode is dedicated to a separate year of the war, from 1941 to 1945. From the first German attacks to the long-awaited Victory. "Live Voices" not only tells about these terrible events, but also about the lives of people who went through the war. Their stories are immortalized in the poems of Soviet poets, many of whom were on the front lines themselves.

name: ЧТО ЕСЛИ?
summary: A sketch show fantasy. What would happen if something went differently in the life of a person you know?

name: Подкаст Разгром
summary: A podcast for your mood

name: Серия подкастов Алексея Стаховича про друзей
summary: The podcast is dedicated to true friends, friendship, and its significance in life.

name: Гик или не гик
summary: "Geek or not Geek" is a stand-up comedy show hosted by Andrey Atlas, where he interviews guests to learn about their hobbies and what they prefer to do in their free time.

previousepisode.name: ЯСЯ 13КО и АНДРЕЙ САЛЕЕВ. В семье не без задр#та

name: Ann Droid
summary: It's Sue's worst nightmare - an overly attentive, socially inept, second-hand robot carer. But maybe this droid has its uses...

name: Disavowed
summary: Legendary CIA Case Officer Brad Griffin is abruptly fired in the middle of a global hunt for an elusive assassin responsible for killing his colleague. Disgraced and outcast from the world of intelligence, all bets are off when Brad decides to go after the 15 million dollar federal bounty on the assassin's head.

name: Must Love Dogs
summary: Must Love Dogs follows CFL All-Star Brady Oliveira and realtor-rescue influencer Alex Blumberg - a Winnipeg power couple navigating high-stakes rescues, the electric rush of the Blue Bombers football season, and a relentless race to place every last dog before winter closes in.

name: Highway to Heaven
summary: Highway to Heaven is a reboot of the classic 1980s TV show of the same name. The new series will keep the original's uplifting, emotional storytelling and themes of compassion, humanity and second chances while putting an original spin on its premise of a "probationary angel", who is sent to Earth to earn his wings by helping people in need.

name: Lukkhe
summary: Lukkhe is an adrenaline filled, musical drama set in the beating heart of Punjab. Lucky, a sportsman, and Sanober, a musician, find their romance caught in the crossfires between police officer Gurbani and upcoming rapper, MC Badnaam, steering a collision course of tough choices that will come to decide the future of all things that Lucky and Badnaam hold dear.

name: Jupiter Jones
summary: A spin-off of ALLBLK's popular original series A House Divided, following fan-favorite Jupiter Jones - a sharp-witted lawyer tackling high-profile scandals and conspiracies while battling a haunted past. A thrilling mix of legal drama, betrayal, and redemption.

name: Lost To You
summary: At 17, Zhan Wang returns from Beijing to his hometown, carrying a secret diagnosis of terminal brain cancer. There, he meets Xu Yuan, also 17 — a top student who has been branded by the entire town as a child of misfortune. Both have been abandoned by fate, yet they crash into each other's lives with devastating force. Will their relationship bear a tragedy or a miracle?

name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
summary: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

name: Bienvenue à Kingston-Falls
summary: In Kingston Falls, Detective Gabriel Serpent's vacation is interrupted by a corpse whose buttocks, protruding from the ground, are being used as a bicycle stand. With his police station facing closure, Serpent is determined to prove his worth by leading the investigation. But the arrival of Cynthia Quinn, nicknamed "The Tracking Dog", a formidable detective with a drinking problem, throws everything into disarray.

name: Kevin McCloud's Listed Britain
summary: Kevin travels the length and breadth of the country to uncover the stories behind some of Britain's most remarkable buildings and structures, exploring why places as diverse as Coventry Cathedral and the Penguin Pool at London Zoo have been judged worthy of the highest level of protection.

name: The Alibi: Ang Buong Katotohanan
summary: The Alibi: Ang Buong Katotohanan dives deeper into the intriguing love affairs of Stella and Vincent and the mystery involving the murder of Walter, which will lead to shocking plot twists and revelations.

name: Kazoku Robinson Hyouryuuki: Fushigi na Shima no Flone
summary:
10-year-old Flone is a very active, tomboyish sort of a girl in Bern, Switzerland.

One day, her father was asked by his friend to come down to Australia because of a serious shortage of doctors, so the family decides to leave their old house to Australia, however, they drift to a deserted island after the shipwreck and must supply their needs by themselves.

Flone's fantastic adventures will teach children about the importance of family and the joys of living amidst nature's beauty.

name: Двойная жизнь Ми
summary: During the day, it's school, friends, and first love. In the evening, it's the stage, filming, and new hits. Mila balances between two worlds, but keeping a secret becomes increasingly difficult. This is a comedy with Milana Khametova in the spirit of "Hannah Montana."

name: Crime and Punishment
summary: Living in squalor, a former student and loner (Raskolnikov) murders an old pawnbroker woman in order to confirm his hypothesis that certain individuals can pretermit morality in the pursuit of something greater.

name: Smile After Tears
summary: Optimistic and cheerful transfer student Zhang Jun-jia has always used his smile to get through everything—until he meets He Yan-kai(Xiao He). Xiao He is the dazzling lead singer of a band: aloof, stubborn, and born with a heart condition, yet he refuses to let anyone pity him. Through music, the two boys find their way to each other, and an unspoken attraction quietly begins to grow—until a sudden accident forces them apart. Jun-jia falls into endless longing and grief, until he realizes that Diao-qin, a member of the basketball team, has always been quietly watching over him, appearing whenever he needs someone most. Will fate smile on Jun-jia once more?

name: Thee and Thee
summary: When an AI sucks Khun Thee into the world of a novel he's written, he discovers he's become a supporting character and Peach is the protagonist. Khun Thee must compete against the AI to fix the story, reclaim his memories, and choose his own ending before their love is forever rewritten!!!

name: Nation's Dumbest
summary: Nation's Dumbest is the first television show where the loser is the winner. Celebrities fight it out to be eliminated from the competition as quickly as possible to avoid being crowned the nation's dumbest. From influencers to wrestlers, comedians to politicians, the contestants are put to the test in a series of physical and mental rounds about all the things you really should know.

name: True Heiress vs. Fake Queen Bee
summary: Hailey Kaplan, a wealthy teenager who decides to conceal her true identity when she transfers to Western High, a public school. Tired of being known only for her family's wealth, Hailey hopes to make genuine friends and experience a normal teenage life. However, her plans are thrown into chaos when Candice Mathis, the daughter of the Kaplan family's maid, arrives at school posing as the Kaplan heiress. Candice quickly rises to the top of the social hierarchy, while Hailey finds herself at the bottom, subjected to bullying and ridicule.

name: Karna The Guardian
summary: Karna lives as an ordinary boy—until the ancient demon Kalimba breaks free and spreads corruption across the world. When the darkness infects his mother, Karna's powers awaken, revealing his true identity: the Balancer, a Guardian born to restore harmony to the world. To save his mother and stop Kalimba's chaos, Karna must train to master the power within him—or risk losing everything.

name: Soccer Meets America
summary: From immigrant roots and early pro leagues, to the thrilling 1994 FIFA World Cup and the rise of a new generation of fans, the series traces how soccer finally became part of the fabric of American culture.

name: Escorting the Heiress
summary: Serena caught her boyfriend, Ken cheating on her with her half-sister, Carol. He had always lied about holding it all in till marriage.  Furious by their actions, Serena gets drunk and ended up in the bed of Jesse. She thought he was her escort but he was a man who has been inlove with her for years.

name: Please, stop!
summary: A story about a younger brother's secret crush on his older brother—who only has eyes for girls. For the older brother, this love is a "happy trouble"; but for the younger one, it's a silent storm.

name: My Secret Husband Is My Boss
summary: Kate married a stranger in order to secure her inheritance without ever seeing him. She returns two years later get a divorce, not knowing that her hot billionaire boss and crush Jack Townsend is her secret husband.

name: Until We Drown
summary: If Time Could Rewind, I Wouldn't Love You. Cheng Yu x Cheng Jiang

previousepisode.name: Time Could Rewind, I Wouldn't Love You

name: Awakening the Steppe
summary: On the endless grasslands, initial misunderstandings give way to an awakening of the soul as two men from different worlds fall deeply in love.

name: Rookie Truckers
summary:
It's one of the world's toughest and most dangerous jobs. And as a nationwide driver shortage threatens to stall Australia's economy, a new generation of Rookie Truckers is stepping in to take the wheel. Guiding them through this baptism-by-fire are Yogi, Steve, and Sludge—three long-haul veterans determined to pass on the torch before they hang up their keys.

Facing blowouts, breakdowns, and extreme weather on the open road, the Rookie Truckers are pushed to the limit to earn their stripes—and a full-time job. They meet all kinds of colourful characters as they crisscross the continent. And along the way, fine-tune their survival skills, master the art of bush mechanics, and grow into the truckers who will keep Australia moving. Gritty and gripping, it's a high-stakes all-terrain journey packed with rugged landscapes, real drama, and storylines of mentorship and transformation.

name: Bon Cop, Bad Cop
summary: In Bon Cop, Bad Cop, David and Martin team up for an investigation that takes them across Canada after the band chief of an Indigenous community in Gaspésie mysteriously disappears. They are joined by a new cadre of cops who are just as unorthodox as they are: Gabrielle, David's daughter, who has her father's stubborn streak; Joe, an intrepid Micmac police officer from Gesgapegiag; and Kim, a Sureté du Québec lieutenant who is generally skeptical of David's methods.

name: Ultimate Boys Trip
summary: Three OUTtv stars -- Boomer Banks, Max Konnor, and Joey Mills -- head to Miami for a wild hotel residency, but when Drake Von joins, clashing egos and unresolved drama erupt, turning their "ultimate boys trip" into explosive chaos.

name: Newlyweds
summary: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

name: Buonvino - Misteri a Villa Borghese
summary: Following a serious error during a raid, Deputy Commissioner Giovanni Buonvino is relegated to a bureaucratic post at the Villa Borghese police station in Rome. But what appears to be a tranquil place turns out to be a microcosm of puzzles, mysteries, and unspeakable secrets.

previousepisode.name: C'è un cadavere al Bioparco - Parte 2

name: Tuva & Ronny – eit lite hotell i Hellas
summary: Tuva and Ronny have a dream of starting a small hotel in Greece. After a brutal life crisis, they now put everything on the line. It turns out something completely different than expected.

name: My Staycation Boy
summary: When Phut, a workaholic office employee, gets so drunk that he can't unlock his own room, he accidentally walks into the apartment of a stranger he mistakes for his best friend next door. The next morning, he discovers the truth — the man is Sunday, his friend's twin brother who has just moved in. What begins as an awkward drunken encounter soon turns into regular meetings every Wednesday, Sunday's day off. A carefree hairstylist who values life's simple moments, Sunday is the complete opposite of Phut, whose life revolves around work. Before long, an ordinary midweek day becomes the one Phut looks forward to the most. As love changes the perspective of a man who never knew how to rest, Phut must choose between a life consumed by work… or a heart that wants to pause with his Sunday.

name: Не ссорьтесь, девочки!
summary: Sonya, Yulia, and Nonna have been friends since childhood. Time passes, but it seems the women haven't found their niche yet. Sonya designs and decorates apartments, although she could have become a skilled art historian. Yulia is a talented fashion designer who makes her living by drawing tattoos. Nonna is a qualified, but unpracticing, theater director. After some amusing events, our lovely trio decides to write a book, "How to Get Married and Be Happy."

previousepisode.name: «Свобода, свобода», «Шла Саша», «Чумачечая весна», «Яхта, парус», «Любит наш народ»: хиты 2011

name: Liées par le crime
summary: Twelve women linked to organized crime share their reality alongside mobsters, outlaw bikers and street gang members. They reveal secrets and lasting trauma, while experts shed light on the enduring impact on their lives.

name: Palu Ailesi: Karanlık Sarmal
summary: An investigation into one of Turkey's most shocking cases -- and how one man was able to enact total control over a tight-knit family.

name: Game of 2 Halves
summary: Game of 2 Halves host Laura McGoldrick referees NZ's favourite chaotic comedy quiz. Kiwi sporting legends and NZ's funniest people enter a brutal battle arena of sporting trivia and comedic chaos.

name: Ready Gamer Mum
summary:
Ready Gamer Mum is a high-energy, funny competition series that flips the gaming world on its head. Ten of the country's best bedroom gamers go head-to-head – but there's a catch – their mums will be in charge of the controllers!

They'll need to coach, motivate and somehow transform their mums into champions, but adding to the chaos, each episode features a real-life challenge inspired by that week's videogame – forcing the players and their mums into the real world to recreate what's on screen, with outrageous and hilarious outcomes.

name: My Summer of You
summary: Chiharu Saeki and Wataru Toda are two high school students who share a common hobby. They love to watch movies. After they meet, they become fast friends until one day, their relationship takes a sudden twist. What does it mean to love someone? What can you really do about it? Follow the story of their adolescence and relationship as it unfolds through a brilliant summer.

name: A Cappella
summary: A Cappella was NRK's national competition for children's and youth choirs airing between 1992 and 1994. The series consisted of four episodes, including semi-finals for children's choirs and youth choirs (mixed and equal voices), as well as a final.

name: A4
summary: Program hosts Marit Sofie and Ravna invite children to join in marking the International Year of the World's Indigenous People; 1993.

name: Absolutt norsk
summary: A tribute to Norwegian popular music. Host Rune Larsen has his regular supporting players Jan Eggum and Atle Halstensen in the studio.

name: Adamseplene: Full pupp
summary: Humor series with a Finn who cooks psycho soup, sheep farmer Odin Jensenius who believes in the individual, two 12-year-olds who always sit on the bench, two cool Tromsø students and a number of other funny things. Sometimes with the trio Ivar Nergaard, Klaus Joacim Sonstad and Hans Petter Nilsen.

previousepisode.name: Så tenner vi fire lys i kveld

name: Adventskort
summary: Postcards from the Middle East signed Odd Karsten Tveit.

name: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss
summary: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she's about to enter.

name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
summary: This bold and contemporary reimagining brings The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo into the present, grounded in the characters and investigative DNA of Stieg Larsson's Millennium novels, with themes that carry heightened relevance today.

name: Мой близкий враг
summary: Liza and Alexandra Smirnov are sisters, but no two people could be more different. The elder, Alexandra, is a demon, using people for her own ends, heedless of the consequences. The younger is an angel incarnate: everyone's favorite, an excellent student, and her parents' hope. Alexandra has always envied her sister, and at her sister's wedding, even to spite Liza, she seduced the groom. This was the last straw for the girls' father—in a fit of anger, he revealed a secret the family had kept hidden for years: Alexandra isn't his biological daughter; he married her mother while she was already pregnant. Shocked by this news, the elder sister leaves. Now she will seek revenge—on her parents for lying, and on her sister for receiving more love than her.

previousepisode.name: László Panna, Szulák Andrea, Scherer Péter, Frei Tamás, Vad Kati és Dr. Dubóczki Zsolt

name: LOVEx3
summary:
Six students must face different lessons in love — a love closer than they ever imagined, a love they must run to catch up with, and a love that returns carrying an old promise — before they can grow, hearts and all, through "LOVE×3 The Mandatory Love Course." 
X1: The love story of a high school boy secretly in love with his best friend — only to be roped in as Cupid, helping him woo someone else. 
X2: The love story of a senior student council president who must win the heart — and the LINE ID — of the school's most adorable underclassman star. 
X3: The love story of a younger student bound by an old promise, secretly in love with his own brother's best friend — keep waiting, or let it go?

name: Little Amadeus
summary: The life and times of a young Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart as he goes on adventures and learns lessons on the way.

name: Changzhou Never Quits
summary: This heartwarming and inspirational drama revolves around the growth and struggles of an amateur football team in Changzhou. Composed of ordinary citizens, the team suffers one crushing defeat after another, yet never once gives up. From a bleak and dismal start, the players gradually rally together under the guidance of their coach and the unwavering support of their families and the entire city, ultimately earning both respect and hard-won growth.

name: The First Sight of Nanyang Overseas Chinese
Vow in Ashes
summary: In the twenty-fourth year of the Changhe era, the death of the founding emperor sparks a fierce battle for the throne. Yan Qingshu is falsely accused and forced into a broken engagement, only to witness the destruction of her family. After being rescued by Xiao Jingyan, the two form an alliance and return to the capital seeking revenge. Together, they uncover the treasonous schemes of Prince Ling, the Xie family, and other powerful forces conspiring against the throne. Through countless life-and-death trials, their partnership gradually deepens into love. In the end, they join forces to expose every conspiracy, overcome the chaos of a turbulent era, and restore peace and order to the nation.

name: Our Ocean Table
summary: On a journey inspired by iconic Korean seafood dishes, filmmaker Sonya Lee and journalist Hannah Sung uncover the deep links between cultural identity and ocean conservation.

name: A Company Isn't A School!
summary: With the first place in a university business competition and a father running a time-honored leather bag store, Yusuke Tsuruta is in the "outstanding" category among university students. After graduation, Yusuke decides to start a business with his classmate Kengo Sato. After declaring that "Company is not school!", he works hard every day to make his business successful.

name: Entre padre e hijo
summary: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

name: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
summary: Best friends Mordecai and Rigby work and live at a local park. Somehow, their mundane jobs always descend into surreal chaos, much to the annoyance of their boss and co-workers.

name: P.A.Y.
summary: Renowned Turkish painter Osman Hamdi Bey's "In Front of the Green Mosque" is sold to a private foundation for a hefty sum but is stolen during the transfer. An underground network attempts to smuggle it from a decaying warehouse, unwittingly bringing together a group of strangers with clashing motives. Among them are criminals, vengeful lovers, a grieving bird breeder, a runaway banker, and a kidnapped taxi driver. Unaware of the larger scheme, they find themselves entangled in a high-stakes clash over stolen art.

name: Hack Mack
summary: Häck Mäck, Bebe and Uncle Pudding live in a far-off corner of the universe. Here, rain falls in the form of confetti. People go fishing in the hope of catching moonlight rings. And storms are stored in bottles like precious wines.

name: Labyrinth of Flames
summary: Galan, a college student fascinated by Japanese samurai culture, receives a real sword from his friend Natsu. Unbeknownst to him, the sword is a betrothal gift, leading to an unexpected adventure.

name: Alien Nine
summary: In a world where humanity is intertwined with aliens, a trio of young adolescent girls are elected for alien fighting as they are forced into growing up with symbiotic life-forms.

name: The Thought Verification Zone: The Community
Baddies Gone Wild: Dominican Republic
summary: WILD takes over the DR in Baddies Gone Wild's sophomore season.

name: Hot Ones Wing Pong
summary: "Hot Ones" spin-off series where guests answer questions and play a variation of Beer Pong.

previousepisode.name: The 'Outer Banks' Cast Plays Hot Ones Wing Pong

name: Как уходили кумиры
summary: Sometimes we feel like we know more about their lives than we do about our own. Their names are on everyone's lips. They are famous. They are stars. But all stars fade sooner or later. And humans too die. However, the death of a famous person is an event that leaves no one indifferent. They left us in different ways. Some left young, in the prime of their creative powers. Others lived long and fruitful lives. But no matter when they passed, their death is an irreparable loss for the entire country. In its new program, "How Idols Passed Away," DTV will reveal unknown details of the final days of great Russian figures, idols of recent times—outstanding actors and directors, poets and writers, TV presenters, and masters of sport.

name: The Goodbye Family
summary: Lorin Morgan-Richards brings his Old Weird West world to life in this animated series about town undertakers: the Goodbye Family.

name: Froglets
summary: For the Froglets, the human world is a giant playground full of everyday challenges and wonders that spark an urge to adapt, get creative, play and have lots of fun along the way.

name: Small Town Escapes With Colin and Justin
Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas
summary: Lisa Vanderpump has been ruling over the Las Vegas strip for years now, with three hotspot restaurants serving up chic cocktails in her signature whimsical settings. Now, she is expanding her Vegas empire through the opening of her high-profile namesake hotel. In this limited series, we follow the behind-the-scenes dash to make the property worthy of the Vanderpump brand. LVP shares what inspired her newest enterprise and pulls back the curtain on the down-to-the-wire drama. The series will culminate at The Vanderpump Hotel's lavish opening party, with fan-favorite Bravolebrities celebrating the launch.

name: Челябинский раджа
summary:
One day, an ancient ring associated with the Indian legend of Raja and the magic stone that can transport its owner's consciousness into the body of the heir to the throne falls into the hands of Vasily Lebedev, a simple man with a complex personality who drives a taxi in Chelyabinsk. 

Now, whenever he faces danger, Vasily finds himself in India, in the body of a young Rajesh, the heir to an ancient royal family. With a second chance in a different body, Vasily sets out to redefine his life, regain the trust of his wife Maria, mend his relationship with his son Sasha, and become the person he always wanted to be.

name: Dastane Yek Shahr
summary: Dastane Yek Shahr is an Iranian television drama series created by Asghar Farhadi that follows a diverse team of young journalists and producers working on a social documentary program called "In the City" for Tehran's Network 5. As they investigate and report on various contemporary social issues facing urban Iran, the personal lives, relationships, and moral dilemmas of the crew members become inextricably linked to the stories they cover, creating a meta-narrative that blends documentary realism with character-driven fiction.

name: Mi Rival
summary:
Paloma, a humble young woman, marries Porfirio Cruz, a wealthy landowner in San Luis Potosí. During a local fair, she meets Renato, and an undeniable attraction sparks between them. Torn by guilt, Paloma returns to the hacienda to care for her ailing husband.

As Porfirio's health declines, he entrusts his estate to his friend Gustavo, who secretly plots to take control by installing his protégé, Renato, as administrator. Renato's arrival reignites his connection with Paloma, trapping her in a loveless marriage while confronting her true feelings. But as tensions rise, Bárbara, Paloma's daughter, also falls for Renato, unaware of their past.

Mother and daughter soon find themselves on opposite sides of a forbidden love, becoming rivals for the same man.

name: Nurse the Dead
summary: Nurse the Dead follows Noa Reyes, a driven Filipina nurse supervisor whose ability to see ghosts — referred to as her "third eye" — makes her the go-to handler for a hospital ward teeming with restless spirits. Juggling demanding apparitions alongside staff burnout, family pressures and a coworker who seems to know more about her than expected, the series grounds its supernatural premise in the cultural specificity of the Filipino healthcare experience.

name: The Golden Elevators
summary: The Golden Elevators turns seemingly simple A or B questions into a game like no other, as ten contestants take on the game, each other, and two elevators in a bid to reach the penthouse and a huge cash jackpot.

name: Wordle
summary: Wordle challenges players to solve five-letter word puzzles in a battle of smarts, speed and fun. It builds on the way the puzzle community engages with Wordle every day — solving together, sharing wins, debating strategies and cheering one another on. Now, that style of play comes to life as the most obsessed and competitive players will team up in squads and go head-to-head in the Wordle arena, playing for an incredible cash prize.

name: Escorted
summary: In Escorted, a divorced dad in Manhattan accidentally becomes a male escort in this romantic comedy about sexual dynamic, keeping secrets, and whether real intimacy can ever be bought.

name: Rose Hill
summary: Rose Hill follows best friends and neighbors West Belmont, a rancher with commitment issues, and brooding record label owner Ford Grant, aka Forbes' "World's Hottest Billionaire," who's long carried a torch for West's sister, Rosie. And when country-pop star Skylar Stone breezes into their rugged mountain town, the heat gets turned way up in this romantic family drama.

name: Ride or Die
summary: Ride or Die follows best friends Debbie Claybourne and Judith Burton who thought they knew everything about each other, except Judith turns out to be an international assassin. When a mysterious figure emerges from Judith's past and a hit goes horribly wrong, both of their worlds are turned upside down as they're forced to go on the run together. It's a race against time and a road trip across Europe, with law enforcement, highly trained assassins, and some very dangerous criminals at their heels.

name: Проект «Фамильные тайны»
summary: "Family Secrets" is an animated project about the origin and distribution of surnames in Russia, the Russian Empire, the USSR, and Russia.

name: КЛУБ ПОСЛЕДНИХ ДЖЕНТЛЬМЕНОВ
summary: The Last Gentlemen's Club is a gathering of select representatives of the art of comedy. Here, news is discussed, global issues are addressed, and the traditions of true gentility are upheld. Wit, manners, and nobility are highly valued, but being a gentleman is a privilege that must be earned.

previousepisode.name: #13 | Еременко, Сидоров, Киселев, Быченков | Платье в шкафу

name: Стендап за 60 секунд
summary: An interactive stand-up show where each comedian only has 1 minute to perform, after which they stay on stage and interact with the hosts. Unpredictable interviews, no censorship, and multiple comedians at once.

name: ЗАМЕТКИ
summary: Notes is a show podcast where Seva Lovkachev and Kolya Andreev scourge each other's notes in an attempt to find the explosive shit that will make them popular.

previousepisode.name: #37 Егор Кукса, Коля Андреев и Сева Ловкачев | Стендап шоу

name: Декабрьское безумие
summary: Alexey Stakhovich's "December Madness" podcast series is about the festive mood, traditions, gifts, and the atmosphere on the eve of the New Year.

previousepisode.name: Финал. Павел Дедищев Леван Табарокишвили. Павел Вернидубов. Алексей Стахович

name: Space Angel
summary: Scott McCloud is the Space Angel, a secret agent for EBI (Earth Bureau of Investigation) on board the spaceship Starduster fighting hard to protect the solar system.

name: Roozegar-e Javani
summary:
Five young students from other Iranian cities studying in Tehran rent a house and live together. Each of these five people has a different personality and they encounter a new story in each episode. But in the end, they help each other overcome the problems.

Reliable airdates for the episodes/seasons are virtually impossible to find.
Season 1 aired somewhere between March 1998 - March 1999 (1377, Solar Hijri).
Season 2 aired somewhere between March 1999 - March 2000 (1378, Solar Hijri).
Season 3 aired in 2021 (1399, Solar Hijri).

name: Yadashthaye koodaki
summary: Khan Baba and Raba Khanum have been caretakers of Agha Bozor's house since they were young, and now that they have reached old age, the residents of the house no longer visit them. One day before Ramadan, Hamid, one of the grandsons of Agha Bozor, comes home and asks Khan Baba to imprison him in one of the rooms of the house.

name: Poshte Konkooriha
summary: Siavash is interested in a girl named Maryam. He wants to marry her despite her family's opposition, but the girl's family is not very interested in this marriage. One of the conditions that the girl's family leaves to marry the boy is his acceptance in the university entrance exam, so Siavash joins with several of his friends, Mohsen, Ramin, Majid, Hamed, each of whom has special conditions and different motivations of studying.

name: The Crow Princess of Fortune
summary: Suisui, the young mistress of the Mystic Crow Clan, is blessed with great fortune and can communicate with beasts. But after being mistaken for a jinx, she is abandoned at a mass grave. After crashing a marquis manor banquet, she saves Xiao Heng, the cursed Prince Jing. With her divine powers and clever mind, Suisui breaks curses, drives away evil, outsmarts schemers, exposes hidden palace secrets, and helps the prince reclaim his strength. From a feared "jinx" to a beloved lucky princess, she joins forces with her father to defy fate and turn their destinies around.

name: Bao Ye De Xiao Zu Zong You A You Sa
The Roman
summary: The Roman is set in the high-stakes, sharp-elbowed present-day Las Vegas casino business, which is a modernized but still dangerous version of the legendary city. At the center of which stands Robert "Bobby Red" Redman, president of the hottest hotel casino in town, who has to make some long odds moves to try and secure his position and take more ground.

name: The Adventures of Brigadier Wellington-Bull
summary: Retired army brigadier Garnet Wellington-Bull struggles to adjust to civilian life.

name: The Emerald City
summary: Three gay men, Frank O'Dowd, Steve Bie, and Gene Stavis, came together during the mid-1970's in New York City to form Truth, Justice, and the American Way, Inc. As a company, they produced a show for community access cable television called The Emerald City which covered a variety of issues in the gay community. The program aired in New York City on Manhattan Cable's Channel J beginning in March 1977 and was syndicated in San Francisco. Originally an hour long show, it switched to a half-hour in the fall of 1977. The Emerald City ran from 1977 to 1978 and had both gay and non-gay commercial sponsors.

name: Untold UK
summary: The critically acclaimed docuseries UNTOLD pulls back the curtain on epic tales from the wild world of football. And yes, we mean football. Each character-driven story hinges on candid, intimate first-person accounts from those who lived it.

name: Two D's and a Dog
summary: Two D's and a Dog follows Dotty Charles after the death of her father, as she travels with her friend Dingle Bell and her dog Fido in search of work.

name: 100 Cooks
summary: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up. In the end, 99 chefs will be eliminated, and one talented home cook will prove they are the best of the best with a chance to win up to $250,000.

name: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
summary: A fresh take on a classic, Restaurant Impossible: Last Call follows acclaimed chef Aarón Sánchez and dynamic Canadian restaurateur Jen Agg as they lead the charge to rescue struggling restaurants across North America. This isn't about a quick fix - it's about digging into real problems, adapting to a new and challenging restaurant industry, and finding creative, unexpected solutions tailored to each business. While Jen tackles design and front-of-house issues, Aarón gets to work on the culinary side, each assessing exactly what needs to change for the restaurant to thrive. From horrendous Yelp reviews and staff DMs for help to feuding family members, each episode reflects the varying challenges facing today's restaurateurs. Emotions are high, and the stakes are critical as Aarón and Jen strategize each location's rescue plan, all while navigating the greater changes happening in an industry being forced to evolve.

name: Dan the Donut Man
summary: Dan the Donut Man follows Dan Cole – self-proclaimed "Donut Daddy" and Chief Donut Development Engineer at Dunkin' – as he travels across America in search of culinary inspiration for his innovative, outrageous and sometimes unhinged donuts. After soaking up each city he visits, Dan heads back to his Donut Lab, where he translates those experiences and flavors into two wild donut concepts. Armed with his creations, he returns to the city for taste tests with locals, who determine which donut best represents their hometown. Some donuts will have fans drooling while others may have them scratching their heads – but they'll all have everyone talking about Dan the Donut Man.

name: Wildcard Kitchen: High Rollers at Sea
summary: Wildcard Kitchen: High Rollers at Sea takes host Eric Adjepong's game beyond the kitchen and into international waters, where the rules are different and anything can happen. In this arced tournament, Eric's invited some of the most memorable chefs from his table. The ones wild enough to say yes, bold enough to compete at sea and talented enough to handle whatever chaos comes their way. Who will be the last chef at the table with the biggest pot of money the game has ever seen.

name: Extreme Buyers Club
summary: Charismatic Texas real estate agent Noel Collier will flex her specialty of helping clients with the most wildly unique property requests find their dream homes in the new HGTV series Extreme Buyers Club. During the season, she'll step into each buyer's surprising—and sometimes shocking—world to experience how they live and then scour the market for out-of-the-box listings that fit their unprecedented wish list. Whether a recent divorcée seeking acreage for dozens of llamas, a ghost-obsessed couple searching for a haunted home, or a professional mermaid needing lots of water, no house hunt will prove too extreme for Noel and her team.

name: Roast My Rental
summary: Roast My Rental, comedian, truth-teller and design enthusiast Leslie Jones will crash America's worst short-term rentals, whose viral photos of amenities gone wrong, misleading listings and brutally honest reviews have scared guests away. After Leslie's hilarious roast of the property and a no-nonsense reality check, she and her experienced design team led by HGTV star and home renovation expert Jasmine Roth will come to the rescue and help the owners clean up the chaos in just 72 hours. They'll fix the flaws, transform the houses into top-tier vacation escapes and give the ‘roastees' a chance at redemption when the next guests come to stay.

name: A Very Haunted Renovation
summary: A Very Haunted Renovation, will follow six brave renovators and designers who will stay at one of the most haunted houses in America for 31 days with only one mission: completing the renovations.

name: House Shock
summary: House Shock, unsuspecting homeowners nominated by their sneaky loved ones will receive surprise makeovers for the spaces they've neglected, abandoned or just plain hate. Series host and designer Arielle Vandenberg along with a resourceful construction team led by builder and former Battle on the Beach winner Steve Lewis will keep each edge-of-your-seat renovation on track and on time. With secret planning, stealthy distractions to keep the recipient away, hidden cameras and dramatic room reveals, the 20-episode season will deliver heart, humor and the occasional shock—because not every reno surprise is exactly what a homeowner wished for.

previousepisode.name: A Reno She Never Saw Coming

name: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
summary: In August 2004, a naked and injured man was found behind a Burger King in rural Georgia. Claiming to suffer from a rare form of amnesia, he called himself Benjaman Kyle. In 2014, with the help of filmmakers Shannon and Eric Evangelista, he set out to piece together his forgotten life. But as cracks in his story emerged, producers uncovered realities that revealed disturbing inconsistencies in his past, revealing three cold cases and a possible connection to a powerful Midwestern crime family. As new evidence surfaces, the producers face mounting threats, placing one of their own in danger and revealing the devastating cost that can come with chasing the truth.

previousepisode.name: The Man Who Knew Too Much

name: Maine Cabin Masters: All Inn
summary: The Maine Cabin Masters take on their most ambitious build yet: transforming a rundown B&B into a stunning 12-acre lakeside inn. Along the way, Chase and his wife, Sarah, bring their long-held dream of becoming innkeepers to life.

name: Fixer Upper: We Bought a Money Pit
summary: Chip buys a sprawling Texas mansion he swears is a great opportunity only to end up with a serious money pit. With no buyer after years on the market, Joanna steps in to transform the outdated estate into a beautiful home that—fingers crossed—will finally sell.

name: Most Extreme Humans
summary: Most Extreme Humans follows people from around the globe living with the world's rarest and most remarkable physical conditions. From a Filipino man whose hands have grown so large he wears wristwatches as rings, to Brazil, where the world's smallest married couple have a combined height under six feet, to a 19-year-old in India living with the ultra-rare condition known as "werewolf syndrome." This series examines what everyday life looks like when the world is not built with your body in mind.

name: Little Singles
summary: Little Singles features a tight-knit group of friends from the little person community as they come together for an unforgettable vacation under one roof. For years, these friends have met annually at national conventions and have become a chosen family. The closeness they share carries the drama of complex relationships, romantic entanglements …and a whole lot of fun!

name: ER: Caught on Camera
summary: Real patients revisit their most intense ER experiences, combining firsthand interviews with raw footage of the emergency as it happened, while ER doctors break down in real time what happened and why.

name: Born Talking: A Personal Inquiry Into Language
summary: Jonathan Miller presents this documentary exploring the complexities of language.

name: Barbaric
summary: Barbaric centers on a ruthless and crass barbarian who is cursed to only use his violence for good, which sends him, his talking axe and a young witch on a road of self discovery, redemption and revenge.

name: Tui Hun Hou，Wo Dui Fu Ren Si Chan Lan Da
Calabasas Confidential
summary: Fresh out of college, a tight-knit group of friends, exes and rivals returns to hillside SoCal luxury and unfinished drama in this opulent reality series.

name: Das Dritte Reich Privat
summary: After the fall of the Third Reich, details about the private lives of Nazi leaders came to light. Film footage and photographs reveal the daily lives of Hitler, Göring, Goebbels, and Bormann, as well as the lives of Germans under the dictatorship.

name: Connect with Jacob Soboroff
summary: Connect with Jacob Soboroff will be the network's first Los Angeles-based program. Built around the connection Soboroff has forged with the MS NOW audience for more than a decade, Connect will bring viewers closer to the stories shaping the country. Connect will also bring Soboroff's storied reporting from the ground in Los Angeles and beyond to help connect the dots between what's happening in local communities throughout the country and larger national conversations driving politics, culture, and daily life.

name: The Moment with Katy Tur
summary: The Moment with Katy Tur is designed to move beyond the immediate headlines to provide deeper context and understanding of the political and national stories shaping the day.

name: On the Line with Alicia Menendez
summary: On the Line with Alicia Menendez moves beyond the headlines to examine the stories shaping the nation, featuring one-on-one conversations with newsmakers and a focus on voices often left out of the political discourse

name: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
summary: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle, utilizing her extensive Wall Street background to analyze the high-stakes intersection of money, power, and politics, Stephanie Ruhle delivers original reporting and hard-hitting interviews on the stories that directly affect Americans' lives. The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour

name: Mi Shu Da Ren Bu Hao Re
A Different World
summary: They're young, gifted and Black — and ready for a freshman year they won't forget. Meet the tightest crew at the country's top HBCU.

name: Human Vapor
summary: When the Human Vapor announces a killing spree, panic erupts. A reporter and detective close in on the truth — and face Mufu, pulling society's strings.

name: Vi skal til VM!
summary: The men's national team is ready for the World Cup for the first time in 28 years. But how will they learn from their past mistakes and avoid the same fate as the United States?

name: Shou Fu Da Ren De Xiao Jiao Qi
Wo Bi Xu Zhan You Ni
Hui Jia De Mo Sheng Ren
Engineering by Catastrophe
summary:
Across the globe, engineers are creating extraordinary modern masterpieces, structures that push beyond the limits of what came before. Each year, innovations grow more impressive as bridges, tunnels, skyscrapers and even spacecraft become bigger, bolder and more ambitious. Yet, every breakthrough brings new risks. 

To ensure the safest outcomes, engineers must study worst-case scenarios in which major structures are pushed to their limits and fatal flaws are exposed. Fires, explosions, floods and catastrophic collisions are difficult to confront but essential to understand. 

In this series, we learn from the past to build a safer future.

name: Tou Ting Wu Sui Xiao Yi Xin Sheng，Zheng Dun Shang Hai Tan
The Princess Came From The Demon World
Ta Chi Lai De Jiu Shu
Shu Zhong Yao Nu Lai Xian Dai Shi Jie Nue Zha
Leng Qing Nue Ai：Fu Xian Sheng De Di Yi Zui Qi
Tang Dynasty Occult Mysteries
summary: In the flourishing Tang Dynasty, Li Jinglan, the gifted daughter of a prefect, possesses an extraordinary talent for forensic investigation and solving mysteries through autopsy. Together with the enigmatic "Ghost Detective" Jueming and the highly skilled constable Su Yu'an, she embarks on a series of perilous investigations, unraveling one bizarre case after another: the deadly identity swap of twin sisters, a scholar's wrongful conviction buried for seventeen years, and a string of ritualistic murders committed during an elegant literary gathering. Amidst bloodshed and deception, Li Jinglan and Jueming gradually develop deep feelings for one another, supporting each other while steadfastly upholding justice and breaking free from the shackles of fate. Beneath the dazzling lights of the prosperous empire, they use wisdom and courage to cleanse corruption and darkness, forging a legendary tale of righteousness, truth, and integrity.

name: Life is Elsewhere
summary: In the age of new media, Jiang Zi is an ordinary and unlucky girl who keeps pushing forward, longing to be seen. Determined to become a content creator, she quits her stable job in her hometown and moves alone to Beijing. There, she gets the opportunity to work with her former idol, Ivy. The two become both rivals and friends — admiring each other while constantly competing. Smart, capable, and fearless, Jiang Zi gradually carves out her own place in the fast-paced world of new media. Along the way, she meets Luo Xin, an adorably awkward engineer. What begins as a bickering relationship slowly turns into deep companionship. Luo Xin becomes her refuge from the pressures of the workplace and the person who pulls her out of despair. But just as Jiang Zi reaches the peak of success, she begins to question the true meaning of her work in the new media industry. After a major mistake, she is sidelined by her company and falls to the lowest point in her career. With the support of Luo Xin and Ivy, Jiang Zi eventually finds the strength to reinvent herself, achieving both personal growth and a new breakthrough in her career.

name: Tales of the Floating World
summary:
Thousands of years ago, a little demoness on a tree fell in love with the God of Water. After a tragic and disappointing love story with him, she lived alone in the present world and became the owner of a dessert shop called "Everlasting." She brews a tea known as "Floating Life," and many strange customers come to her shop.

Each guest, after drinking the tea, tells a story—a tale of love, hatred, and heartbreaking passion among demons: a handsome demon boy who falls in love with a fish, a magical fox who protects a prophetic flower, a golden lion roaring at the sky to save his beloved, and a midnight butterfly warrior burdened by a strange past who slays demons…

Every customer who visits the dessert shop has a story. And like the "Floating Life" tea, each story blends bitterness and sweetness after countless twists and turns.

The tree demoness listens quietly to their tales. Yet she herself is still searching for her own path in life. Her journey involves Zi Miao, Jiu Gui, Ao Qi, the fat man, and the thin man… In the end, where will they all go?

name: Qiang Wen Shi Zun Hou Wo Chong Sheng Le
LightKeeper of Jigu Temple
summary: During the era of warlord chaos, an old medic and drunkard known as Old Drunkard returns to his hometown and takes shelter in the Bone Resting Temple. There, he saves a widow, Ru Ling, and exposes the sinister conspiracy behind the "Mountain God Child Sacrifice," eventually taking up the mantle of the Light Keeper. He takes the wayward youth Dong Sheng under his wing, helps him crack an arms smuggling case, and rescues Qiu Ying from being offered as a living sacrifice. With wit and grit, he battles a vicious cult and liberates imprisoned patriots. In the end, Old Drunkard passes away in peace, and every life he saved goes on to devote themselves to the revolution.

name: The Another Universe
summary: The Sainz Group is a leading enterprise in human quantum technology in the future world, and they are developing a quantum computer that can travel through time and space.

name: Соль. Легенда
summary:
Salt.Legend is a new music show on the REN-TV and VK Video channels, where famous artists will meet on the same stage and try their hand at the most "tough" genre – Russian rock!

Pop music has always been considered fake and plastic in people's minds, and pop artists have been seen as production projects that don't know anything. Therefore, in our show, we will give pop musicians live bands, guitars, and a live backing line so that they can show that they are also real musicians.

The people who were at the origins of music in Russia – the soloists of cult rock bands and invited jury members – will evaluate the boldness of this musical experiment. Together with the audience, they will determine who is truly worthy of the title of "Legend of Russian Music".

name: Yue Shang Han Xing Zhi Wu Bao Shi Cheng
This Land
summary: This Land traces America's rise from a fragile string of colonies to a continent-spanning superpower - as told by experts and descendants of the men and women whose sacrifices and struggles shaped the nation we live in today. Explore the history of America's expansion through six defining frontiers.

previousepisode.name: Dat zaad is nog het enige wat over is

name: Round One
summary: When professional boxer Zack and sports journalist Nick inexplicably find themselves in a time loop, the two must work together to figure out what destiny wants them to fix as they are forced to relive the same day over and over again.

name: Outback Wreckers
summary:
Mike Elliot and his team of scrap metal junkies are the Outback Wreckers – their mission - to scour the harsh Aussie landscape for wrecked and abandoned cars, in search of valuable parts to be stripped out and sold for export.

As Mike always says, ‘one's man's scrap is another man's gold' and business is booming for the team of Outback Wreckers!

The Australian Outback is littered with dumped and damaged cars and the Outback Wreckers make it their mission to clean it up and make some cash along the way.

name: Mom's the Bride
summary: In Mom's the Bride, each episode follows an adult woman who is planning her mother's dream wedding, with help from Erin Cahill and Hallmark. Flipping the script on the traditional "mother of the bride" role, the series honors the reciprocal love and support that can make the mother-daughter bond so profound. Viewers will follow the road to the altar from planning, to cake tastings, to dress fittings and the big day. Every ceremony is a love letter from a daughter to her mother.

name: Marilyn and the Mob
summary:
1950s Hollywood was a fairytale city of movies, glamour, money, and fame, a dreamland that the world had never seen before. At its heart was the biggest star of them all, Marilyn Monroe.
But beneath the glitz lay a much darker reality - the brutal and cold-hearted mob that had its claws in the entertainment industry and manipulated the most famous faces of the era – including Marilyn, a superstar whose iconic life was shadowed by dangerous liaisons, including her alleged affairs with both John and Robert Kennedy and rumoured Mafia connections.

This two-part documentary takes a deep dive into the final weeks of her life, investigating her relationship with known mobsters like Sam Giancana and how she became a pawn in the Mafia's power plays. As we explore the blurred lines between Hollywood, politics, and organized crime, the series speculates on whether Monroe knew too much and whether her death was more than a tragic overdose.

With archive footage, high-end graphics and expert interviews, we will uncover how Marilyn was used, abused, and ultimately lost in a game of power, politics, and betrayal, to explore one of the most infamous intersections of celebrity, crime, and political scandal in American history

name: Parents Know Best!
summary: Mums v. Dads in the first ever game show that puts the skills required to be a parent to the ultimate test.

name: Nobody's Fool
summary: A brand new quiz with a great big twist. It's not about how smart you are, but how smart your rivals think you are. Expect lying, scheming, and a whole lot of quizzing.

name: Yo siempre a veces
summary: A pregnant woman navigates life as a single mom in Barcelona, facing ups and downs as she raises her toddler son in the vibrant Spanish city.

name: It's Ok to Be 30
summary: Turning thirty, Ploydao has hopes for success in her career and her relationships, but she couldn't feel farther from it. She works for a capitalist organisation and their demands don't sit well with her at all. Fortunately, she meets Namkhang, a psychologist whose advice leads her to quit her job and gives her the chance to restore relations with old friends, including former-boyfriend Chanin who's now running an enormous clothing business.

name: Gameoverse
summary: Gameoverse is an action drama about video game worlds!!! And their heat death. Only one Cat girl can save them by... helping the villains?

name: Ban Saran Land: Suparburoot Sut Soi
summary: The story of three single, very different brothers. The oldest, Earth, born in 1983, is fastidious, loves kids, and wants to have a family. He's so freaking picky, though—he's got no chance of finding a wife. The middle brother, Win, born in 1987, is a handsome playboy, loves the single life, doesn't want to be tied down and can't stand kids. The youngest, Sun, born in 1993, is a foul-mouthed student, obnoxious in the way of Gen ME and always finds new ways to cause his brothers a headache. One day, the brothers learn their father who left them when they were young has passed away, leaving behind their five-year-old half-sister Cher. Unable to bear seeing her end up in the foster system, they adopt her.

name: Speechless
summary: A filmmaker's decade-long investigation into the campus culture wars that have redefined free speech and civil discourse, in the very places that were meant to protect those ideals.

name: The Land
summary: Follows a sprawling, multi-generational family drama set in the world of the NFL.

name: The Old Stories: Moses
summary: The Old Stories opens a window into the narratives that shaped Israel long before David took the throne. As the past unfolds with epic force, a young shepherd sees his own future reflected in the courage, failure, and obedience of those who came before him.

name: The Sacred Thread
summary: In a cinematic journey, explore the Lord's Prayer across the landscapes where Jesus first spoke it. Hosted by Brad Gray and featuring insights from N. T. Wright and other scholars, learn about the prayer's cultural, historical, and spiritual depth.

name: Exam
summary: A determined young woman with a mysterious past enters the dangerous world of the Regional Public Service Exam (RPSE) scam to expose a powerful paper-leak network. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a corruption chain embedded deep within the education system-and must bring it down before it destroys the dreams of an entire generation.

previousepisode.name: The Fish That Hunted for the Duck

name: Camarades
summary: May 1968. The Gaullist government creates the University of Vincennes to contain the students revolt. Claudine, a prostitute from the Bois de Boulogne, agrees to infiltrate this nest of leftists for the French intelligence service.

name: I'm a Monster
summary: Famous and obscure monsters talk to camera and introduce us to their worlds. They tell us all sorts of fun facts and theories about themselves — where they come from, how they became famous, and how they feel about their reputations

name: 34 Yillik Orzu
summary: This 8-part documentary series chronicles the dramatic journey of the Uzbekistan national team from the 1998 World Cup qualifiers to the 2026 World Cup qualifiers. Through chronicles, interviews, and the experiences of players, coaches, and fans, the series demonstrates our nation's confidence in its dream of qualifying for the World Cup each time. This is not just a story of football, but a mirror of the nation: failures and hopes, victories and defeats, the transition of eras and generations. At the center of the events is not only the team, but also the people, who always believe: "This time we will definitely make it!"

name: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?
summary: Two children barricade themselves in their room—and livestream the 54-day standoff on TikTok, captivating the nation. Why?

previousepisode.name: Part Two: 54 Days in the Barricade

name: Carísima
summary: Caro Pardíaco, bubbly influencer and full-time diva, has it all — but in the midst of a midlife crisis at 30, she falls into the trap of romantic love.

name: Desi Bling
summary: Glitzy parties and delicious secrets rule the lives of ultra-wealthy Indian expats as they spare no expense — or drama — in this reality series.

name: James.
summary: In this documentary series, James Rodríguez, Colombia's legendary No. 10, shares details of his journey to football's elite and the game's biggest stage.

name: Take me to your comedy club
Jiang Ye
summary: After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.

name: Cucine da incubo
summary: Chef Antonino Cannavacciuolo visits struggling restaurants and tries to save them.

name: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
summary: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.
